title: Area: 1983–1987

description.main: An illustrated history of the New York nightclub Area, 1983-1987, by two people from its own circle.
description.extended:
An illustrated history of Area, the Manhattan nightclub that ran from 1983 to 1987 and drew the downtown art, music and fashion crowd.

The club occupied a former stable building at 157 Hudson Street and redecorated around a new theme every six weeks, with themes including Art, Confinement, Suburbia and Science Fiction. Its invitations arrived as objects: capsules for the September 1983 opening, hollowed-out eggs for the Natural History theme. The book gathers that material with a foreword by Glenn O'Brien and principal text by Stephen Saban.

Eric Goode, one of the club's founders, and Jennifer Goode, who worked in its art department, edited the volume from inside the scene. It records one of the three hot clubs of 1980s lower Manhattan, alongside Limelight and Danceteria.
